请联系管理员配置应用主页: Ask an administrator to configure the application homepage
应用接收注销令牌的 HTTPS 地址；留空停用: HTTPS endpoint receiving logout tokens; leave blank to disable
邮件和短信服务未配置或配置无效，发送请求将返回 503。: Email and SMS services are missing or invalid; send requests return 503.
查看近 30 天的投递记录；发送服务接收不代表收件人已收到。记录不含验证码、链接: Delivery records for the past 30 days. Service acceptance does not confirm receipt. Codes, links and full recipient addresses are omitted.
当前签名能力异常，请检查有效期与私钥: Signing is unavailable; check key dates and private material
签名正常，但密钥将在 30 天内到期，请安排轮换: Signing is healthy, but the key expires within 30 days; schedule rotation
先添加并计划激活新密钥，旧公钥保留至安全撤销时间；撤销会停止旧令牌验签。: Add a replacement and schedule activation. Retain the old public key until safe retirement; revocation stops old token verification.
仅限密钥泄露：立即停止签名并移除公钥，所有旧令牌验签会失败，可能中断登录。确认继: For a compromised key only: immediately stop signing and remove the public key. Old tokens will fail verification and login may be interrupted. Continue?
撤销会从公钥集移除此密钥，旧令牌将无法验签。确认已超过安全撤销时间？: Revocation removes this key from JWKS and prevents verification of old tokens. Confirm the safe retirement time has passed?
通知渠道尚未配置或配置无效，暂时无法发送。: The delivery channel is missing or invalid; sending is unavailable.
请先激活替代签名密钥。: Activate a replacement signing key first.
旧令牌仍需此公钥验签，请等待安全撤销时间。: Old tokens still require this public key; wait until the safe retirement time.
轮换计划无效，请检查密钥状态及有效期。: Invalid rotation schedule; check key status and validity dates.
注销通知地址必须为公共 HTTPS 地址。: The logout notification URL must be a public HTTPS endpoint.
权限已被其他管理员修改，请刷新页面后重新比较。: Permissions were changed by another administrator. Refresh and review the differences again.
权限依赖不完整或作用域不正确。: Permission dependencies are incomplete or the scope is incorrect.
全局用户权限影响所有非管理员账户。应用权限只对明确选择的应用生效；新应用不会自动: Global user permissions affect all non-administrator accounts. Application grants apply only to selected applications. New applications receive no automatic grants. Saving changes requires the administrator to sign in again.
撤回该应用全部权限: Revoke all permissions for this application
尚未分配权限，可返回个人中心。: No permissions have been assigned. Return to your account.
超级管理员拥有所有权限；普通管理员按全局能力和具体应用分配权限。: Super administrators have all permissions. Administrators receive explicit global and application permissions.
高影响：可启停应用及调整自动访问资格: High impact: enables or disables applications and changes automatic access eligibility
高影响：可修改登录回调、scope、类型及创建客户端密钥: High impact: changes login redirects, scopes, client types and creates client secrets
包含 IP 等全局敏感元数据: Includes global sensitive metadata such as IP addresses
高影响：可编辑应用资料及启停应用: High impact: edits application details and enables or disables application access
撤销访问后，用户仍可能通过注册或邀请流程重新获得资格。: After access is revoked, registration or invitation may grant eligibility again.
网络连接失败，请检查网络后重试。: Connection failed. Check your network and try again.
登录已失效，请重新登录。: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
此操作暂不可用，请检查权限或联系管理员。: This action is unavailable. Check your permissions or contact an administrator.
记录或页面不存在，请刷新后重试。: This record or page no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
数据已发生变化，请刷新后重试。: The data has changed. Refresh and try again.
操作过于频繁，请稍后重试。: Too many requests. Please try again later.
应用接收签名事件的 HTTPS 地址；保存后同步现有成员，留空停用。资料按客户端: HTTPS endpoint receiving signed events. Changing it synchronizes existing members; leave blank to disable. Profile fields follow client scopes.
账户同步已启用，请由超级管理员调整类型和 scope。: Account synchronization is enabled. Ask a super administrator to change the client type or scopes.
完成身份验证后继续登录。: Verify your identity to continue signing in.
输入用户名搜索，仅可选择匹配的用户。: Search by username and select a matching user.
不能修改自己的管理员角色，请由其他超级管理员操作。: You cannot change your own administrator role. Ask another super administrator to make the change.
自动填充公共配置，所有字段仍可修改。切换预设保留已填的 Client ID、密钥: Public settings are filled automatically and remain editable. Switching presets preserves your Client ID, secret, and account policies.
微信开放平台（网站扫码登录）: WeChat Open Platform (website QR code sign-in)
填写应用注册概述中的租户 ID（GUID），自动填充租户专属端点，填充后仍可修改: Enter the tenant ID (GUID) from your app registration overview to fill tenant-specific endpoints. The filled values remain editable.
用于区分登录渠道和生成回调地址，例如 google 或 microsoft；创建: Identifies the sign-in provider and its callback URL, for example google or microsoft. Cannot be changed after creation.
用户在登录页看到的名称，例如“公司 Microsoft 账号”。: The name users see on the sign-in page, for example “Company Microsoft account”.
按服务商接入文档选择；使用预设时已自动选好，创建后不可修改。: Choose the protocol specified by the provider. Presets select it automatically. Cannot be changed after creation.
从服务商应用控制台复制应用 ID；微信对应 AppID。启用登录前必须填写。: Copy the application ID from the provider console (AppID for WeChat). Required before enabling sign-in.
从服务商应用控制台复制密钥，微信对应 AppSecret；是否必填以服务商要求为: Copy the client secret from the provider console (AppSecret for WeChat), if required by the provider. Leave blank when editing to keep the existing secret.
OIDC 身份签发者的完整地址，须与服务商元数据中的 issuer 一致，启用: The full OIDC issuer URL, matching issuer in the provider metadata. Required to enable OIDC.
浏览器跳转到服务商登录和授权的地址；预设已填好，自定义接入请查阅服务商文档。: The URL users visit to sign in and authorize. Filled by presets; consult the provider documentation for custom setups.
服务器用授权码换取令牌的地址，由服务商提供。: The provider endpoint used by the server to exchange an authorization code for tokens.
获取登录用户身份和资料的接口地址，启用登录前必须填写。: The endpoint for fetching user identity and profile information. Required before enabling sign-in.
服务商公布 ID Token 验签公钥的地址，仅 OIDC 需要，启用 OIDC: The URL publishing keys used to verify ID tokens. Required only for OIDC.
申请读取的用户资料权限，以英文逗号分隔。OIDC 必须包含 openid，微信网: Profile permissions to request, separated by commas. OIDC requires openid; WeChat website QR sign-in uses snsapi_login.
允许新用户通过此渠道注册，仍受系统和应用注册策略限制；关闭后仅供已有账号登录或绑: Allow new users to register through this provider, subject to system and application registration policies. When off, only existing accounts can sign in or link.
开启后会出现在登录页；暂未填齐配置时可关闭，先保存为草稿。: Show this provider on the sign-in page. Turn off to save an incomplete configuration as a draft.
可选，登录按钮使用的图标；留空使用协议默认图标。: Optional icon for the sign-in button. Leave blank to use the protocol default.
可选，通常保留 {}。例如 GitHub 可设置 emails_endpoint: Optional; usually leave as {}. For example, GitHub uses emails_endpoint to fetch email addresses. Presets include the required settings.
此应用已开启 MFA: MFA is enabled for this application
此应用未开启 MFA: MFA is disabled for this application
设置验证器以开启 MFA: Set up an authenticator to enable MFA
本次授权已过期、已结束或登录账号已变化。请返回原应用重新发起登录。: This authorization has expired, ended, or the signed-in account has changed. Return to the original application and sign in again.
账号 {{0}} 尚无 {{1}} 的访问资格。: Account {{0}} does not have access to {{1}}.
请联系管理员开通此应用权限，完成后回到本页重试。: Ask an administrator to grant application access, then return here to retry.
请在新窗口申请或查看应用访问资格；审批通过后，回到本页重试。若资格已被停用，请联: Request or check application access in a new window, then return here to retry after approval. Contact an administrator if access has been disabled.
